description:
See Key West the way it was meant to be seen — by water, slowly, with a USCG-licensed captain who actually knows the history. Three hours along the historic waterfront aboard the 30' Jeanneau yacht: Mallory Square, the old shrimp fleet docks, the Truman Annex, Sunset Pier, and the working harbor that built the island. Your captain narrates the wreckers’ era, Hemingway and Buffett years, Spanish-American War navy presence, and the modern fishing fleet. No tour bus required.

Quick facts:

itinerary:
Departure – Perry Hotel & Marina
Meet at Dock A, Slip #32. After a brief safety overview, we cruise into the calm waters surrounding historic Key West.

Historic Harbor Exploration
Enjoy a scenic route that may include:

• The Historic Seaport District
• Mallory Square waterfront
• Sunset Key
• Wisteria Island
• Key West Harbor anchorage
• Waterfront estates and liveaboard communities
• Naval Air Station waters (as permitted)

Your captain customizes the route based on weather and your interests — history-forward, scenic cruising, wildlife spotting, or sunset-focused.

Optional Golden Hour Cruise
Time your charter to experience the harbor glowing under the golden light of sunset.

Return Cruise
Relax as we glide back toward the marina with panoramic views of Old Town’s waterfront skyline.

special_requirements:
